annotations.title: Look up a price quote choice

description: Looks up the current choices for one price quote question whose list is long or depends on an earlier answer: vehicle makes, models and body styles for a model year, a vehicle from its 17-character VIN, occupations within an employment industry, and current insurers whose name matches a search.

line.description: current_insurers: whether the current auto insurer or the current home insurer is searched.

list.description: Which list: vehicles (makes for a year, models for a make, body styles for a model), vehicle_by_vin, occupations, or current_insurers.

make.description: vehicles: the make. With a year and a make the models come back.

model.description: vehicles: the model. With a year, a make and a model the body styles come back, each with its id.

search.description: current_insurers: the first letters of the name, two or more. occupations: optional words to narrow the list.

year.description: vehicles: the model year. With only a year the makes come back.

name: look_up_price_quote_choices
title: Look up a price quote choice
